creator: Alexander Terp
description:
**Doing:** Foreman's factory ends a run once none of the run's agents has an unanswered question to the owner. It reads posts through Muster's API.
**Happened:** `Post.author` and `Group.members` are strings. When the author is a pane ID, Foreman can tell which run the question belongs to. When it is a name, nothing binds the name to a pane, so Foreman holds every running factory run until the question is answered.
**Fix:** give the API a binding from a post or a participant to its pane, such as `Post.source_pane` or a participant record carrying a pane ID.
**Where:** Mac, ~/src/foreman, `internal/factory/runner/tracker.go` (Fencil `factory-run-observation`).
title: API: a post does not say which pane sent it
